name_input: BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LIMITED; BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LTD.; M/S BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LIMITED; BSL ENGINEERING SERVICES LIMITED; BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for 'BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LIMITED' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/bsl-engineering-service-limited) states 'Total Shipments 36 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-05', but every visible row is an IMPORT into India, e.g. '2026-02-05 | ROTORS TRADE S R O | BSL ENGINEERING SERVICE LIMITED | SPRING CTTI 60.7601 (PARTS FOR STEAM TURBINE MACHINE)... | CHENGDU, CHINA -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 84069000 | BOL 7327097'. No export row, no outbound destination, no export B/L was seen. Counter: page claims 36 shipments; only 5 rows were actually rendered and all 5 are imports (HS 84069000, 38249900, 84069000, 84069000, 84133020).
note: Declared HS 840681 (steam turbines) does not match observed trade: the company appears in Indian customs data as an IMPORTER of steam-turbine spare parts (HS 84069000 - parts of steam turbines), plus one unrelated consignment of coated calcium carbonate (HS 38249900) and a main oil pump (HS 84133020). Per project rules the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground; actual observed code is 84069000 (parts of steam turbines) for the core activity. No export shipments found in the one accessible source; volza, eximpedia, trademo, thecompanycheck and zaubacorp all returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused), so export_status is 'none_found' rather than a definitive negative. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved - all registry/aggregator pages blocked - so domestic_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN confirmed. Address fragment seen in customs data: 'D-10, NEB VALLEY, NEB-SARAI' (Delhi). Trading partners observed: 2 counterparties, 3 port lanes (Chengdu, Chennai Sea, Delhi Air Cargo).
